name: ruge_boogie
description: Smack a piñata or celebrate Cinco de Mayo with Ruge Boogie. This two-font set is a fun and bouncy style with a joyful flair. Great for scrapbooking, tubes, and other fun stuff. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/ruge-boogie .
